text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the deserted island project hitting a milestone, today was the final meal day. And so—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
The fish is all set, Mr. Tucker!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "Man, thanks to you, this is gonna turn out pretty luxurious. Much appreciated!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I got treated to heaps of delicious grub, after all.
As the leader, at least let me help out at the end!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you doing, Leader Tamamo?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm just helping prep the staff meal!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that! If Tamamo-san's doing it,
we wanna do it too~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, those guys are way too hyped up!
Looks like it's gonna turn out crazy extravagant~.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Tama. Why do you think I suddenly
decided to appoint a leader among you all?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, obviously...
Isn't it just better to have someone leading the pack?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
Well, plainly speaking, yes, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
After spending nearly three years here, you must understand now.
A deserted island is a harsh environment.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Even with supplies brought in and arranged,
it's still a world away from everyday life.
Working in a place like this is tough.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Especially... when you were all already busy
balancing races and academics. I figured participating
on top of that would be considerably grueling.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why! In moments of crisis, I felt everyone needed someone who could be the first to dash forward and inspire those around them."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That's why I put Tama in charge as the leader.
...Turned out to be the best choice!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's with you all of a sudden? You're making me blush!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Haha. Having a place to belong, the Umamusume must have felt at ease looking up to and relying on you.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "We united naturally. ...Though some strange incidents occurred because of me, nobody was hurt or suffered an accident."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Once again, thanks, Tama!
I'm really glad you were our leader.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Tama, you... you went to go look for the runts for me, didn't ya...!

text_block_list.name: Young Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Mm... I'm sorry. Don't cry, now.
We're both safe and sound. Right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm talking about *you*.
Your legs are totally wobbling..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. Truly, thank you.
I'm real glad that you're the big sister to the little ones.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, it just suddenly came back to me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Both Dad and Mom had it so rough every day.
It frustrated me that I couldn't do anything to help.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why... what Mom said that day
made me so happy—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That was the day I finally figured out
what I was supposed to be doing in that house."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Tama?
What's wrong, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, nah.
Just remembering old times.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right then, time to cook, time to cook~!
'Cause everyone's starvin'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the deserted island project finished, her job as leader was done too.
Tamamo Cross had fulfilled her duty to the very end!
